parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou, which indicates an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance
parameters.help_zh: DoS高防实例所属地域ID。取值固定为cn-hangzhou，表示中国内地，即DDoS高防（中国内地）服务
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource to which the tag belongs. Set the value to INSTANCE, which indicates an Anti-DDoS Pro instance
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。取值固定为INSTANCE，表示DDoS高防实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the specified resource. Valid values:

true: yes.
false no. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否移除资源上的所有标签。取值：
true：表示是。
false（默认）：表示否
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: An array consisting of the IDs of instances from which you want to remove tags
parameters.help_zh: 要移除标签的DDoS高防实例的ID列表
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: An array consisting of the keys of the tags that you want to remove
